Latin Capital Letter Thorn Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Capital Letter Thorn is 0222. Hold Alt, type 0222 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Capital Letter Thorn also has the Unicode codepoint U+00DE, so you can type it with Alt+222 on Windows, search for U+00DE in macOS's Character Viewer, use Þ in HTML, or \00DE in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Capital Letter Thorn character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity Þ for Latin Capital Letter Thorn, but the numeric form Þ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin capital letter thorn on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 2 2 2 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Capital Letter Thorn character (Þ) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin capital letter thorn on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Capital Letter Thorn. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Capital Letter Thorn" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin capital letter thorn in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00DE"; ()
  • Python: \u00DE or chr(0xDE)
  • JavaScript: \u00DE or String.fromCodePoint(0xDE)
  • JSON: "\u00DE"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Capital Letter Thorn?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Capital Letter Thorn is 0222. Hold Alt, type 0 2 2 2 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type Þ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as Þ, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+222 not work?

Alt+222 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Capital Letter Thorn?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Capital Letter Thorn is U+00DE. You can use this value in HTML as Þ, in CSS as \00DE, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type Þ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00DE, then click it.
